description: Bitcoin mempool pressure state and projected next blocks. Class (low/normal/high/extreme) is determined deterministically: extreme if next block median fee >= 50 sat/vB or backlog >= 150 vMB; high if >= 20 sat/vB or >= 60 vMB; normal if >= 3 sat/vB or >= 10 vMB; low otherwise. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_bitcoin_mempool_stats when you need Bitcoin mempool congestion from mempool.space: unconfirmed; crypto_bitcoin_blocks_range when you need up to 144 consecutive Bitcoin blocks descending. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

maxBlocks.description: Maximum projected blocks to return (1-10, default 8)
